conclusions: State flags and quoted-row limits match the supplied raw daily-state files.
All 162 saved signal cases reproduce from signal-date scores without future returns or future execution states.
Long entries/exits obey their configured state permissions. Short execution intentionally skips limit/ST admission constraints, while requiring a valid non-halted adjusted opening quote.
No direct future-price or future-label use was found in the checked prediction/execution paths; reporting explicitly uses 2018 returns for retrospective selection.
Sources lack announcement/availability timestamps; matching daily records cannot establish full point-in-time announcement availability.
Equal-value ordering in IdealAmplitude and SmartMoney can differ across independent numerical implementations; this is a reproducibility convention, not evidence of future input.
